<slate title="Coffee break">
  <column id="root">
    <empty
      id="no-brew"
      title="The pot is cold"
      body="No turn has reported its context yet. Coffee starts once the agent gets going."
      when={isNull(thread.context)}
    />
    <column id="brew" tight when={exists(thread.context)}>
      <meter
        id="coffee"
        tokens
        label="☕ Coffee in the cup"
        value={thread.context.used}
        max={thread.context.window}
        note={`${pct(thread.context.percent)} full, ${tokens(thread.context.free)} of room left`}
        tone={thread.context.percent >= 80 ? 'bad' : (thread.context.percent >= 50 ? 'warning' : 'good')}
      />
      <text
        id="caption"
        tone={thread.context.percent >= 80 ? 'bad' : (thread.context.percent >= 50 ? 'warning' : 'muted')}
      >{thread.context.percent >= 80 ? 'Cup overflowing. The agent is vibrating at a frequency only dogs can hear.' : (thread.context.percent >= 50 ? 'Half a cup down. Talking faster, remembering slower.' : 'Fresh brew. Sipping politely, remembering everything.')}</text>
    </column>
    <button
      id="break"
      primary
      label="Take a coffee break"
      note={thread.status == 'working' ? 'Waits for the current turn to finish' : 'Asks for a summary of where we are'}
      onPress={queue("Take a coffee break: stop and summarise where we are. What is done, what is in progress, what is left, and anything I should decide.", { with: [thread.context.percent, thread.plan, thread.changes.files] })}
    />
  </column>
</slate>
